_source: Every route, field name and message pattern below was read from the uploaded app.py (FastAPI). No secrets are stored here; credentials come from environment variables.

agent._base_url_source: app.py entry point: uvicorn.run(app, host=127.0.0.1, port=5000). README.txt also says http://127.0.0.1:5000.
agent._login: POST /login, form-encoded fields username and password (Form(...)). Success = HTTP 302 redirect to '/'. Failure = HTTP 200 HTML containing 'Invalid Credentials'. The server upper-cases both values.
agent._logout: GET or POST /logout clears the session; JSON reply when the Accept header contains application/json.
agent._chat: POST /api/chat, JSON body: message, source ('typed' default), language ('EN' or 'UR', optional), evaluation_mode (true returns the generated SQL). Reply JSON: reply, sql.
agent._transcribe: POST /api/transcribe, multipart file field 'audio' (max 10 MB). Reply JSON: transcript. Needs a Groq key on the server.

_language_mode: auto = do not send the language field (the server detects typed language itself). selected = send EN for English and UR for Roman Urdu and Urdu script. app.py accepts only EN or UR. Which one the browser page sends cannot be determined because templates/chat.html was not provided; run both modes if you want to compare.

oracle._dsn: app.py uses DB_HOST=localhost, DB_PORT=1521, DB_SERVICE=FREEPDB1. README.txt also says port 1522; the source code is treated as correct. Change here if your running database differs.

limits._max_display_rows: app.py MAX_DISPLAY_ROWS = 20; more rows produce the 'narrow down' message.

session._timeout: app.py SESSION_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT default 60 (environment variable can change it).

run._isolate: A fresh login per case. The server stores the last chat turns in the session and sends the last 8 to the LLM, so sharing one session would let earlier questions influence later ones.

patterns._note: Regular expressions (case-insensitive) built from the fixed messages in app.py: DOMAIN_MESSAGE_VARIANTS, NO_RESULT_MESSAGE_VARIANTS, TOO_MANY_RESULTS_MESSAGE_VARIANTS, the validator and data-change replies, plus the prompt rules for unavailable fields.
